text:
Aisha Malik: Quorra Labs emailed asking to move into the running preview earlier. go-live target moved up by two weeks.
Tom Reyes: is this the account with PHI concerns?
Aisha Malik: yes, they'll ingest de-identified patient notes into embeddings. they want hosted preview keys and SSO.
Claire Wu: hosted preview ok if we enforce 30d retention and DLP masking for PII. need signoff from compliance.
Aisha Malik: I asked them to fill the quick security questionnaire: https://redwood.app/preview-sec-q?cust=quorra
Quorra Contact: we completed the questionnaire and can provide a sample anonymized dataset this afternoon.
Tom Reyes: can they provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) request? that speeds legal.
Quorra Contact: yes, we can sign. need to confirm temporary extra seats during ramp.
Claire Wu: we can grant +3 demo seats for 72h. highlight: permanent seat increases require contract update. flag renewal risk if they expect long-term bump.
ComplianceBot: Note: expedited review requested. ETA ~36h to confirm masking config if sample data provided.
Aisha Malik: propose a 25m enablement call today 5pm PT to validate SSO + sample data flow. I'll run through the checklist.
Tom Reyes: I'll join for the SSO check. Claire, can you confirm masking approach during the call?
Claire Wu: yes, will bring the DLP checklist and masking examples.
Aisha Malik: action items: 
- Aisha: send invite + questionnaire link to Quorra (ASAP)
- Tom: prepare SSO token-scope verification steps
- Claire: prepare DLP examples + temporary seat approval note
Quorra Contact: thanks, we'll be ready at 5pm and share the sample.
Aisha Malik: react with :thumbsup: if all good.
Tom Reyes: :thumbsup:
Claire Wu: :thumbsup:
Aisha Malik: i'll post call notes and feedback form results in this thread after the session.
